title: 2023 Census generalized county and equivalent cartographic boundaries (1:20 million)
limitations: 2023 Census generalized cartographic boundaries, not surveyed cadastral or legally definitive boundaries.
2023 Census county geography includes Connecticut planning regions, which may not correspond to earlier statistical releases.

Published comparable layer covers all 3,144 county and equivalent geographic identifiers in the 50 states and District of Columbia; other island areas and Puerto Rico are intentionally out of this first county view.
Shape coordinates are preserved directly from source; the geographic datum is not independently transformed and should not be used for parcel-level measurements.
Statistical sources with different geographic vintages require explicit GEOID reconciliation before joint analysis.

2025 CDC PLACES candidate observations contain 3,143 county GEOIDs and omit Texas Loving County FIPS 48301 present in this independently published 2023 Census county geometry. Retain all 3,144 Census polygons; consumer must explicitly display the unmatched CDC county as no data.
